import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianClass
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotScheme

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Scheme.Modules

example {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) : Flat T.hom := by
  infer_instance

example {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (F : X.Modules)
    {V : S.Opens} {U : S'.Opens} (e : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (t : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, V)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' sq.w F) U).hom
        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e t) =
      (((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app F).app U).hom
        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e t) := by
  rw [pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap f g f' g' sq.w F e e' t,
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap_compat sq F e e' t]

namespace Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

noncomputable def grassmannianEvalCanonical (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) :
    (Modules.pullback T.hom).obj ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) ⟶
      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L) :=
  (canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L ≫
    (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map (x.twistQuotientMap L)

theorem grassmannianEvalCanonical_base_epi (L : X.Modules)
    [QuasiCompact π] [QuasiSeparated π] [Flat T.hom]
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) := by
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom) L
  infer_instance

theorem grassmannianEvalCanonical_base_epi_over_field
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom T.hom)).app L) := by
  letI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  letI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  exact grassmannianEvalCanonical_base_epi L

theorem grassmannianEvalCanonical_epi (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T)
    [QuasiCompact π] [QuasiSeparated π] [Flat T.hom]
    [L.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hquot : Epi ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
      (x.twistQuotientMap L))) :
    Epi (grassmannianEvalCanonical L x) := by
  letI : Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) :=
    grassmannianEvalCanonical_base_epi L
  letI : Epi ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
      (x.twistQuotientMap L)) := hquot
  dsimp [grassmannianEvalCanonical]
  exact epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L))
    (inferInstance : Epi ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
      (x.twistQuotientMap L)))

noncomputable def grassmannianQuotientCanonical
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (grassmannianEvalCanonical L x))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T := by
  letI := hEpi
  exact {
    F := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)
    q := grassmannianEvalCanonical L x
    epi := inferInstance
    locFree := hLocFree }

end Scheme.DivFamily

namespace Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

noncomputable def kernelEvaluationCanonical (L : X.Modules) {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T) :
    (Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (kernel q.q) ⟶
      (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L :=
  ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (pullback.snd π T.hom)).homEquiv _ _).symm
    (kernel.ι q.q ≫
      (canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)

end Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

namespace Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

theorem kernelEvaluationCanonical_comp_twistQuotientMap
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (grassmannianEvalCanonical L x))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluationCanonical L
        (grassmannianQuotientCanonical L x hEpi hLocFree) ≫
      x.twistQuotientMap L = 0 := by
  let q := grassmannianQuotientCanonical L x hEpi hLocFree
  change LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluationCanonical L q ≫
    x.twistQuotientMap L = 0
  apply ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (pullback.snd π T.hom)).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  simp only [LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluationCanonical,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change (kernel.ι q.q ≫
      (canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) ≫
      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
        (x.twistQuotientMap L) = _
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change kernel.ι q.q ≫ q.q = _
  rw [kernel.condition, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_zero]
  rfl

end Scheme.DivFamily

end AlgebraicGeometry
